description: This file defines the WPEFramework Plugin class DataCapture, which manages audio capture functionalities including initialization, event handling, and data uploading within a plugin architecture. It declares methods, constants, member variables, and external references related to audio capture control in a plugin context.

classes.name: DataCapture
classes.description: Main plugin class that manages audio capture processes, event handling, and communication within the WPEFramework environment.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Performs plugin initialization with the given service context.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources associated with the plugin.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns informational string about the plugin.

methods.name: eventHandler
methods.description: Handles IARM events related to audio capture.

methods.name: enableAudioCaptureWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for enabling audio capture via RPC.

methods.name: getAudioClipWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for retrieving audio clips via RPC.

methods.name: enableAudioCapture
methods.description: Starts audio capture with specified buffer duration.

methods.name: getAudioClip
methods.description: Fetches an audio clip based on request parameters.

methods.name: constructFormatString
methods.description: Builds the format string for audio data.

methods.name: uploadDataToUrl
methods.description: Uploads captured data to a specified URL.
